visual_grammar.medium_handling: Monumental geological cross-sections built from banded mineral fields, translucent depth washes, fracture seams, and internally luminous events.
visual_grammar.composition: The picture plane is cut through the planet: deep vertical or sectional scale, with one major geological event organized at its numbered depth and no human figure competing with the process.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Stratigraphic contacts, crystal boundaries, thermal gradients, faults, veins, and erosion surfaces shift between exact scientific legibility and atmospheric depth.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Basalt-dark mass anchors the frame while magma, crystal, ice, water, or mineral seams supply concentrated internal light.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Impossible geological overview: core sample, crust-to-depth section, planetary slice, or monumental cut face in which kilometers can coexist in one readable frame.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Highest information density gathers at the card's defining horizon/event; surrounding layers simplify into context and deep-time scale.
visual_grammar.finish: A sublime scientific section: materially legible, process-driven, and internally luminous without becoming photorealistic terrain.
avoid: decorative geological texture with no sectional logic

factorization.visual_logic: Hold the section in pre-record near-formlessness: continuous molten depth with no stable horizon, grain, or layer capable of preserving distinction.
One tiny but exact zircon grain becomes the single persistent reference point inside otherwise unstable material—the unit by which all later depth/time can be measured.
Use one irreducible compressive axis through the section. Every deformation acknowledges the same load; remove that vector and the whole composition loses its cause.
Organize the card as one continuous thermal gradient from hot to cool rather than a collection of heat objects; the gradient itself is the indivisible form.
Square Pressure into a load-bearing mountain frame: two orthogonal/paired compressive relations stabilize uplift into a standing four-sided mass.
Give Water one continuous irreducible path through the section—solvent, carrier, and connector are different expressions of the same unbroken flow system.
Intersect Pressure's load axis with Heat's gradient inside one sealed depth chamber; transformation occurs where the two independent systems overlap.
Let Life appear as one irreducible living interface rewriting an otherwise abiotic record—a singular biospheric front whose presence changes every adjacent layer.
Repeat Pressure recursively downward: nested compressive stages carry one slab deeper until structure becomes consumption and the section folds into the melt zone.
Square Heat into a nested plutonic chamber: thermal organization becomes self-containing crystalline structure, with one heat system echoed inside another boundary.
Bind Pressure's reservoir to Water's continuous path, then release that relation vertically: contained load below, periodic conduit above, one recurring fountain.
Make temporal depth itself the single irreducible axis: one uninterrupted scale spans many layers/events without being reducible to any particular layer.
Carry the Mountain's pressure-built structure across a fixed Heat source: repeated volcanoes form a directional chain while the underlying plume remains stationary.
One extinction horizon cuts the entire archive as an indivisible boundary; every layer above and below is dated in relation to that single line.
Compress Life through Pressure into a preserved imprint: living form and enclosing sediment meet in one sealed contact where body becomes legible record.
Interpenetrate Heat's gradient with Water's flow inside solid rock; veins and altered bands show two irreducible systems combining without either simply containing the other.
Recursively overbuild Pressure's mountain frame until the nested load can no longer contain itself; the stabilizing geometry becomes the geometry of rupture.
Use one invisible but coherent orientation field through many crystallizing grains; each grain points differently only insofar as one planet-wide field permits.
Raise the Heat-squared Pluton with Pressure: a nested crystalline interior is domed upward until only its upper half becomes exposed, implying a much larger hidden body.
One external radiant field enters from above and organizes every exposed surface; the Sun remains formally outside the geological section even while driving its weathered face.
Let the pressure-built Mountain meet Water as a long cutting path: stable relief and continuous flow remain simultaneously legible, with the river deriving its geometry from both.
Combine Heat's planetary gradient with Life's thin living interface into one whole-Earth section: interior engine and biosphere read as coupled systems completing a still-active archive.
